title: Remarks at Cambridge, Ohio
paragraphs: I won't try to make a speech; I couldn't with that [?] going there (referring the engine). I shall simply thank you cordially for coming to greet me. I expect to be in Ohio later in the year. It is a pleasure to see you. I am sorry not to have the chance of talking at length. Thank you. (Cheers and applause)
